final_message:
Created `BRIEF.md`. While verifying the source packets against their own underlying data, I found three of the four headline figures didn't reconcile with the line items, so I recalculated and flagged each in Notes:

- **Finance**: stated total spend ($463,250) doesn't match the line-item sum ($464,000) — used $464,000, giving a $256,000 surplus.
- **Support**: stated close rate (96.4%) doesn't match 1,171/1,250 tickets — recalculated to 93.7%.
- **Delivery**: stated launch date (2026-10-22) doesn't match the phase-duration math against the 10/5 start and the 10/12 holiday — recalculated to 2026-10-23.
- **Security**: stated 95.0% resolution rate checked out fine (76/80).
